# Spanish 07 — Regional, social, professional, and cultural depth

Conceptual deck `deck:es-MX:07`; [execution #23](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/23), [Spanish plan #2](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/2#stage-07), [roadmap #1](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/1), and [pinned §6.8](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/blob/e1d8239b7560f26b092cc7bb97c005738b34361f/languages/es.md#68-domain-specific-near-native-command).

Exactly 1,000 original text cards and mappings occupy es-07-0001–es-07-1000. Each has one reviewed primary hidden objective. All ordinary reviews, the single complete final pass and verified corrections are resolved. This completed draft contributes the final 1,000 to a seven-stage 7,600-card delivery; accepted Spanish remains six stages/6,600 until ORCHESTRATOR reviews and accepts 07. Reconciliation is evidence about the authored text and coverage, not language acceptance or a learner's proficiency.

Production is educated contemporary central Mexican Spanish. The assigned authoring domains are community-program coordination, recurring adult neighborhood/workplace relationships in central Mexico, and storytelling/film, music/arts and public institutions/social history. Individual mappings assert ages only when the source establishes them; a workplace role or long friendship does not by itself establish every participant's adulthood. Local organizations, dialogue, rules and personal histories are original fiction unless a real reference is expressly attributed. Authored conventions do not establish universal Mexican practice, actual law or financial policy. All 23 protected files retain their accepted-base bytes; final preservation and validation evidence is in the PR. Verified starting main: `86d9efdf93778c837a2ff4e17119923db2253b04`, tree `b4d6250ab641d916a0d7ab1c19781ca1625b216e`.

Actual roles: P 943, R 57. Actual primary kinds: construction 8, lexical 872, sound 120. R occurs only in D/G and always has explicit Source/register attribution; there is no R quota. Ordinary Mexican production can include regional vocabulary. An R label does not create productive foreign conjugation or universal usage.

Before each ordinary batch, actual senses/contrasts and prerequisites were enumerated. Authors received selected complete earlier source/maps, the losslessly reversible complete hidden-objective inventory and the full pinned guide. Every separate editor received the complete actual author output, all valid cited earlier source/maps and additional related records needed to resolve findings. Known functions remain known when a new lexical member is taught. Mere visible words, a routine tense/participle, gender change, or a renamed scene receive no additional primary count. Concrete repairs include 0275 favorable reception rather than a repeated greeting, 0341 person-to-person rapport rather than accepting a proposal, 0354 physical garment fit, 0460 a bounded demonstration adjustment rather than a repeated false-certification scene, 0485 irreversible confidentiality loss rather than a burnt-object substitution, and 0810 borradura rather than the already taught displeasure participle. Fields in the ordinary table record the final corrected decisions.

## Primary-reference decisions and limits

Language decisions use the actually read selected [DLE](https://dle.rae.es/), [DPD](https://www.rae.es/dpd/), [DEM](https://dem.colmex.mx/) and [ASALE Americanisms](https://www.asale.org/damer/) bodies. Dictionary meanings support lexical selection; they do not validate every authored community's customs. Direct reads sometimes failed or yielded metadata/JavaScript/omitted bodies. Only a later actual selected body or search-rendered primary text supported a retained claim; failed access was not verification. Unverified candidate senses were excluded or replaced before authorship. No books, songs, exams or corpus sentences were copied.

D0521–0532 attributes bounded work/author/date or institutional-purpose facts to the actual FCE, UNAM/UNESCO, Cineteca, Filmoteca, IMCINE and university catalogue evidence stated per mapping. D0571–0577 distinguishes UNESCO's 2011 mariachi inscription from an INAH son-jarocho abstract discussing nomination, a huapango study's limited migrant-community scope, Revueltas's 1937/1938 versions, a Chávez program credit, Gabriela Ortiz's 2021 composition versus 2022 performance, and a Márquez work credit rather than an asserted premiere. D0597–0600 preserves actual artist/work/place attribution without an invented Orozco mural date or unsupplied Siqueiros interpretation. D0619's Memorial del68 reference concerns its dated 2021 context, not present closure/services. D0631–0640 uses actual institutional missions and narrowly verified dates/history: Conaliteg creation, the 1942–1964 Bracero program, Tlatelolco/2 October1968, Halconazo/10 June1971, promulgation of the 1917 Constitution and the 1923 first Misiones Culturales. No contemporary legal rules, victim totals or copied testimony are asserted. Abstract-only and selected-paragraph evidence is not represented as a whole paper or book read.

F keeps ordinary spelling and useful written reading cues. The DPD permits natural vowel coalescence variation, including educated Mexican speech: careful citation grouping is not a universal spoken ban. H is not a syllable divider; ü in güe/güi signals audible u, not automatically hiatus. Contra reloj is the selected two-word adverbial. Período/periodo, irremplazable/irreemplazable and other explicitly justified dictionary doublets stay single objectives, not automatic accent stripping or extra cards. The original plan's invented rhotic positions in enredo, ronronear and inherente were corrected to the actual words.

G uses the exact attributed source and register per R mapping. DEM tequio3 and mayordomía support bounded local community references without claiming universal obligations/customs. Huarache selects the leather sandal; pambazo the bread; marchante the second entry's regular-customer sense including Mexico. Gringo1 does not establish US nationality from English; gabacho4 is attributed French-related derogatory wording; pocho4's DLE entry itself is not marked derogatory, while the actual recipient can object. Remís has the supplied ASALE regional scope and means hired car with driver, without invented tariff rules. Combi's selected DLE layout sense differs from DEM pesero's public fixed-route/fare sense. Jale is the supplied popular activity word in a specified work context. Chale is the interjection, not the offensive ethnonym. Achis and ñáñaras use their exact Americanisms entries, not homonymous bodily/medical senses. Entenado is not assigned an invented archaic/regional restriction. Missing quiúbole/asquel evidence was not used; already hidden quiubo was not counted again. No character's age, origin or self-label proves generational prevalence, social class, universal acceptability or linguistic ability.

## Actual review process

Unchanged authorized environment evidence was reused: installed Codex CLI0.163.0, exact `gpt-6.1-sol`. There were 25 fresh author/editor pairs (50 ordinary content processes) and 12 fresh final processes, 62 completed content processes in total. Every call was sequential, high reasoning, ephemeral, read-only and structured JSON, with no resume, nested agent, child tool call or child repository edit. All actual wrapper/CLI exits were zero and all reported threads were distinct. Firecrawl was prevented from the first and every 07 call through per-call plugin/server/feature disabling, `--ignore-user-config` and `--no-daemon`; it was neither started nor used. Parent alone read every complete output, resolved findings and saved records. Temporary prompts, raw outputs, reference copies, scripts, logs and caches stay in `/tmp/meiki-decks-es-07/`; none are committed.

Author21 had the full hidden objective for06-0600 but not its complete source; a canonical prelaunch scan printed that semantic match before the parent adjudicated it. The author explicitly flagged the contrariado overlap, and the ordinary editor received the full06-0600 record and replaced0810 with verified new borradura. Later source-specific comparison concerns (coetáneo and congratulating language) likewise received complete related records in the ordinary editor input. These were resolved within the required pairs, not concealed as complete preauthor comparisons or repeated author calls.

Structured schemas added an optional-source reading slot between completed batch19 and batch20, retaining the exact earlier schemas and raw outputs. Empty optional strings are omitted in source. Prompt transports preserve all fields/objectives through checked reversible tables and literal expansion banks; no prerequisite/objective was truncated and no oversized probe was sent. Final pending partitions were subdivided locally before dispatch against both the 1,048,576-character and UTF16-unit ceilings.

### §6.5 upper-intermediate operation — accepted04

The following retains the itemized accepted04 family reconciliation; ranges inherit `es-04-`. [Complete 04 mappings](04.md) and the dated acceptance above supply the exact source/coverage evidence. These are retained accepted judgments, not repeated model audits.

| Guide §6.5 requirement | Actual reconciliation |
| --- | --- |
| Confident subjunctive use | A 0081–0180 extends present-mood complements, factive evaluation, influence, goals, optatives and precautions beyond 03. Earlier forms can remain visible; the new matrix, governed complement or discourse function is identified per row. |
| Past subjunctive | A 0001–0080 and relevant later A contrasts introduce imperfect/pluscuamperfect forms with simultaneous, anterior, prospective, modal and contrary-to-fact readings. Actual actors, reference times and realization are stated; subjunctive does not universally mean doubt or falsehood. |
| Conditional sentences | A 0041–0080 and 0161–0180 develop open, potential, counterfactual and mixed-time relations plus bounded conditional/concessive constructions. Protasis and consequence retain their own time and truth status. |
| Reporting across time frames | B 0181–0240 distinguishes anterior completion, future relative to a past report, current validity, explicit attribution and evidential limits. It rejects mechanical backshift and certainty inferred from a reporting verb. |
| Advanced relatives | B 0241–0340 supplies recoverable antecedents, governed prepositions, possession, object/adjunct roles, indefinite infinitival relatives, restrictive scope and contextual mood/alternative choices. |
| Clitic combinations | C 0341–0400 directly retrieves complete attached forms, new personal-object/recipient frames and fixed pronominal constructions. Fixed LAS is distinguished from an actual feminine transferred object. |
| Passive se | C 0401–0420 introduces new lexical actions and complements in inanimate patient constructions; passive SE and agreement often remain visible support inherited from 03. The hidden verb is not misreported as newly hiding SE or a plural ending. |
| Impersonal se | C 0421–0440 introduces personal direct-object frames and governed intransitives with unnamed human agents. Personal A, a governed resource complement and a passive subject are distinguished. |
| Accidental/affected-person se | C 0441–0470 develops physical/figurative changes with explicit owners, users, planners or experiencers. Affected datives, changing subjects, gradual deterioration and actual triggering events are distinguished; every such SE is not called reflexive. |
| Reciprocal se | C 0471–0480 supplies mutual collaboration, emotional response, support, toleration, courtship and reproach. Both directions are established. Recriminar's reproached content is distinct from the people receiving reciprocal reproach. |
| Reflexive/pronominal se | C 0481–0490 supplies self-portrait, deliberate posture, self-performed grooming and theatrical preparation. Actual actor/patient identity, purposeful pronominal movement and character portrayal receive their particular analyses. |
| Concession and qualification | D 0491–0560 develops factual/hypothetical concessions, degree/status, accepted costs, retained benefits and limited objections. It preserves claims without equating a concession with agreement on everything. |
| Stance and hedging | E 0631–0680 and 0721–0770 distinguish personal perspective, preliminary evidence, inference, graded commitment, negotiable terms and verified versus still-open content. |
| Logical connectors | D 0561–0630 develops topic, order, basis, cause/result, emphasis, alternatives and comparison. Arithmetic, comparison dimensions, causal support and necessary-versus-sufficient conditions remain explicit. |
| Reformulation | E 0681–0720 supplies actual source and restatement for equivalent wording, approximation, ambiguity, correction, distortion, generalization, source updates and emphasis. It preserves actor, beneficiary, quantity, condition, timeline and uncertainty. |
| Register differences | F 0771–0900 supplies actual relationship, authority, urgency, purpose and room to refuse; H 1116–1200 compares spoken interaction and attributed written genres. Longer wording is not inherently more polite. |
| Natural collocations | C's governed verbs, D–E's stance formulas, F's request/repair/accountability frames and G 0901–1070's household, social, work, cultural and reasoning families extend actual earlier senses. Source-specific acceptance and completion remain distinct. |
| Regional discourse markers | H 1071–1085 Spain, 1086–1100 Colombia and 1101–1115 River Plate contain new attributed targets beyond accepted 03; H 1116–1160 adds Mexican-compatible spoken functions. Shared usage is not exclusive to a named country, and regional recognition does not create productive voseo/vosotros drills. |

### §6.6 advanced development — accepted05

The following retains the itemized accepted05 family reconciliation; ranges inherit `es-05-`. [Complete 05 mappings](05.md) and the dated acceptance above supply the exact source/coverage evidence. These are retained accepted judgments, not repeated model audits.

| Actual guide requirement | Mapped ID ranges and teachable evidence | Text adaptation limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Synthesis of several sources | 0241–0420; 0791–0960: original attributed short statements, source relationships, agreement, divergence and faithful reformulation. | Short source components do not establish performance on long authentic sources. |
| Implied meaning and speaker stance | 0421–0610; 1111–1270: explicit wording plus recoverable context, speakers' own judgments, reservations and reactions. | An interpretation stays attributed where intent is not established. |
| Precise qualification | 0241–0610; 0791–0960: stated conditions, uncertainty, degree, comparison baseline and bounded commitments. | Partial evidence remains partial; proposal, agreement and execution stay distinct. |
| Register control | 0611–0790; 1111–1400: audience-sensitive professional explanation, familiar interaction and expressly marked written genres. | No expression is universally more polite merely because it is longer. |
| Advanced collocations | 0001–0240; 0791–1270: useful lexical and governed units with stated arguments, actors and constraints. | The whole hidden unit, its actual contextual meaning and grammatical label must agree. |
| Professional terminology | 0611–0790: work, education, services, nonclinical care and community tasks with recoverable responsibilities. | Fictional local arrangements do not establish technical, medical or legal rules. |
| Long-form argument | 0791–0960, building on 0241–0420: assumptions, reasons, objections, concessions, comparisons and consequences in self-contained original cases. | Cards teach components, not a complete long-argument performance. |
| Natural reformulation | 0361–0420; 0791–1110; attributed H responses: preserve source agency, quantity, qualification and commitment. | Reformulation does not quietly change a proposal into a promise or an unresolved objection into agreement. |
| Fast unscripted listening | 0961–1110; 1271–1370: intelligible written exchanges, continuation, hesitation, repair, boundary and register cues. | No audio, fast listening, imagined prosody or live listening performance was tested. |
| Interruption and turn management | 0961–1110: interrupted point, floor claimant, continuation, clarification or changed stance supplied in the exchange. | Written interaction components do not establish live group interaction. |
